column1: # The conjunctions, one per line: word<TAB>roles (comma-separated).
# clause   joins two clauses: coordinating (and, but, or, so) and subordinating
#          (if, when, because, while, until, before, after, as, since, although,
#          unless). The reader stores the second clause as an adjunct of the first,
#          under the conjunction, the way a time phrase is stored under its
#          preposition. Murphy, English Grammar in Use: Unit 93 (coordinating),
# opener   a word that joins or opens a clause, for the abstention buckets in
#          ladder/abstain: the clause conjunctions the buckets count, plus the
#          relative words (that, who, which, where, whose).
